flags.message: gemini-baseline's retrieval.md reports no retrieval beyond the provisioned inputs and statpack, but its harness log records two attempted corpus queries about voting-rights remedial-map standing, one direct and one through uv, both with a September 17, 2026 decided-before filter. Both results are unobserved: success, failure, returned content, and transfer amounts cannot be determined. The note should account for attempts without claiming they returned nothing. This is a reporting discrepancy, not evidence of outcome leakage; no score or leakage exclusion was changed because of it.
